notes.text: Moves only, verbatim blocks: scraper.py 1171->883 (+ plan_scraper.py 300: Selenium listing engine; listing_extract.py 129: HTML tables + LLM listing extract); RegulatoryFeed.py 1460->727 (+ gazette_pdf.py 171, gazette_summary.py 203, gazette_scraper.py 411). notes.text: gazette_pdf imports 'pymupdf as fitz' (PyMuPDF 1.28.2; 'fitz' is deprecated and requirements are unpinned, and the import is optional, so a removal would have silently dropped to pdfminer). tasks.title: Ask about this data: AI plans any question (guardrailed query or sandboxed calculation), answers shown with schema and meaning

notes.text: Ask about this data (owner chose: AI plans, engine runs, no code shown; heavy maths as a hidden sandboxed Python function; dynamic guardrails). Typed questions -> POST /api/ask -> ask_data: model returns a query (checked against this table's columns/kinds by check_query, then again in the browser by toEngineQuery) or a compute function (ask_sandbox: AST allowlist incl. imports of math/statistics only, child python -I -S with empty env, 8 s, Windows Job Object 512 MB + no child processes, RLIMIT on POSIX, 1 MB result cap, 2 at once) or a refusal. Route: 8 MB body cap, 20 asks/5 min per user, guardrail refusals are answers (200), AI down is 503 (60 s budget via llm_json(budget_s)). Answers show meaning + schema-labelled result table. Reviewer pass: no escape found; its DoS findings (Windows memory, result size, nesting crash, body size, rate) fixed with tests. Live with the real AI: query, filtered query, computed and refusal answers all correct, 0 console errors.

NVIDIA: the .env's LLM_MODEL (nemotron-3.5-lightning) timed out for the whole 60 s on every ask this evening; nemotron-3-super-120b now returns HTTP 410 (retired) but is still in llm_client's default chain; nemotron-3-ultra-550b answered in 25-33 s.

tasks.title: Fix the 2 sandbox tests CI fails on Linux: OS-independent nesting limit, CPU limit a second past the wall clock

notes.text: CI run 37124710958 (feat/ask-anything, merged as #26 while running) failed 2 tests on ubuntu: (1) Linux parses a 3000-deep expression Windows can't, then the import rewrite (NodeTransformer) hit RecursionError -> now an iterative depth limit (MAX_DEPTH 100) refuses before any recursion, new 150-deep test parses on every OS; (2) the CPU limit equalled the patched 1 s wall clock, so SIGXCPU (Linux) / the job's time limit (Windows, flaky locally too) could fire first -> CPU limit is wall clock + 1 s on both, and a signal-killed child reports 'took too long'. 195 tests OK, sandbox tests 5/5 repeats; Linux not available locally (no WSL distro/Docker), so CI on the PR is the Linux check.

tasks.title: Security: fail closed without the proxy secret, empty user id sees nothing, per-user browser storage (A7)

notes.text: Fail closed: get_user_id refuses (401) with no PROXY_SHARED_SECRET unless AWDAX_INSECURE_DEV_AUTH=1 (local dev; added to local .env, documented in AGENTS.md/LOCAL_DEV.md/SITE_STATUS.md/.env.example names); X-User-Id stripped before use; ui_sessions list/get/delete use 'is not None' so '' matches nothing; Pages proxy answers 503 without PROXY_SHARED_SECRET. A7 decided per plan: accountKey() gives the browser's first account its existing keys and every other account base@account (same owner rule as filesDbName) for answers, dashboard, graphs, visits, alerts and file-chat cleanup; alerts also survive a stored 'null'. Tests: 200 + 8 backend OK (new: blank id sees nothing, SSE + WebSocket refuse other users, unconfigured server refuses all, dev-only anonymous), proxy 7/7, frontend gate PASS. Live check over HTTP: A and B each list only their own chat, B gets 404 on A's chat and dataset, blank ids see neither.
